ONE METRO. DIFFERENT PRICE SIGNALS.

October’s housing numbers show why “Austin prices” need a geographic label.

Unlock MLS’s November 11 report puts the Austin–Round Rock–San Marcos metro median sale price at $404,802, down 6.9% from October 2025. Within Austin city limits, the median was $550,000—unchanged year over year.

The metro recorded 2,114 closed sales, down 11.4%, with 13,196 active listings and 6.2 months of inventory.

A key distinction: Unlock MLS attributes the lower metro median to a greater share of lower-priced homes selling. A median describes the mix of homes that closed; it does not mean every property lost 6.9% of its value.

For buyers, compare recent sales in the neighborhood and price range you’re considering. For sellers, use nearby comparable homes to set expectations rather than applying a metro-wide percentage to your property.

These are October residential sales figures, not November results or a forecast.

Source: Unlock MLS, October 2026 Central Texas Housing Report, released November 11, 2026.
